params.title: Interns
params.description: Interns (HBO/WO/MBO-BOL, without employment) on an internship agreement -- explicitly not employees and no payroll input (stagiair-bbl-admin). BBL students are not listed here: they hold a work-study employment contract and appear as contracts of type 'bbl' on the Contracts page.
